summary: Getter with a string guard: loads the object pointer from this+0, forms the string pointer at object+364, and returns it only when strlen reports a non-empty string; otherwise returns null (0).

operations.description: Load the object pointer from this+0.
Compute the candidate string pointer as the object pointer plus 364.
strlen is applied to the candidate string pointer to test whether it addresses a non-empty string.
If strlen is non-zero the function returns the string pointer; otherwise it returns null.
Returns the object+364 string pointer when it names a non-empty string, else null (0).

unresolved: The object type, the purpose of the string stored at object+364, and why a non-empty string pointer is guarded while an empty one yields null are unresolved. Caller sub_463BC0 context has not been analyzed.
